units: metres unless a key says mm
what_this_is: The bench rig: the same inspection loop on a plate of real steel, built from parts that can be bought. The tank scene is what it scales to.

bill_of_materials.part: TT geared motor, 65 x 22 x 20, with 65 mm wheel
LED module for inspection light, 12 x 12
bill_of_materials.where: Lamington Road, and it was missing from the first list

bill_of_materials.part: Mild steel plate, 600 x 300 x 6, with three weld runs
TM-8812 ultrasonic thickness gauge with 5 MHz probe
bill_of_materials.where: instrument dealer or online, not Lamington Road
bill_of_materials.note: RS232C out. The Mextech box lists the cable and Windows software as supplied; confirm with the seller before paying.

bill_of_materials.part: USB to serial adapter, CH340 or FTDI, for the gauge lead
bill_of_materials.note: Only if the supplied lead ends in a DB9 and the laptop has no serial port, which it will not.

bill_of_materials.part: USB to TTL programmer for the ESP32-CAM
bill_of_materials.note: The AI-Thinker board has no USB socket and cannot be flashed without one. It was missing from the first list.

bill_of_materials.part: The laptop, which is the whole of the compute
bill_of_materials.note: Everything runs here: it pulls the picture, reads the gauge, drives the robot and makes the model call. There is no server.

data_path.picture: ESP32-CAM serves a JPEG over wi-fi; the laptop pulls it
data_path.thickness: TM-8812 RS232C out to a USB serial adapter on the laptop
data_path.driving: laptop posts a move to the ESP32, which drives the L298N
data_path.judging: laptop calls Nebius Token Factory, a fraction of a paisa a frame
data_path.compute: one laptop. No server, no Jetson, no rented GPU.
data_path.fallback: If the gauge's serial output will not decode, the reading is typed in or read off the LCD by the same camera. The planner still decides where to measure, which is the part being tested.

porosity.measure: pores in any 100 mm of bead

thinning.measure: remaining wall as a fraction of the original

defects.how: stop the run for 60 mm and restart
run a grinder along the toe of the bead
drill five 2 mm dimples in the bead face

acceptance.measure: pores in any 100 mm of bead

defects.how: burn or drill a 6 mm hole through the bead
grind a 40 mm pocket 2.6 mm deep in the BACK of the plate

acceptance.measure: remaining wall as a fraction of the original

defects.how: grind a 40 mm pocket 2.0 mm deep in the BACK of the plate

acceptance.measure: remaining wall as a fraction of the original

defects.how: leave a corner to rust, or etch it

thickness_model: nominal is 6.0 mm everywhere. A thinning defect removes loss_mm inside patch_mm of its centre, ground into the back face, so nothing on the camera side changes and only the gauge finds it.
